info.title: tempLogin API
info.description: All timestamps are epoch milliseconds. Same-origin cookie APIs require exact Origin on mutations. General rate limit 120/IP/minute; auth 20 and pairing creation 12. No commercial provider sessions are provisioned. See protocol.md for atomic state transitions and security requirements.
